skills.description: This skill should be used when the user (a publisher editor or content director) needs to optimize a basic book topic proposal / topic report into a professional, market-driven, high-value topic plan. Triggers include: 编辑提供的基础版选题策划方案、选题报告、新书策划案、选题方向、立项报告需要深度优化. The skill performs multi-dimensional analysis (4P/4C/STP/SWOT/3C/PEST/波特五力) covering product positioning, content value, author background, competitor benchmarking (开卷数据/同类对标书), reader profiling, marketing strategy, book format suggestions (开本/页数/定价), and sales forecasting. Output: a comprehensive topic optimization report in both Markdown and Word (.docx) formats. Built for Beijing Yilin Lishi Media (北京意林励志传媒) which publishes middle/primary school 大语文 extracurricular readers and supplementary textbooks (教辅), but the methodology generalizes to any K12 阅读/教辅 product line.

skills.description: Generates holiday consumption data report packages for any year and any Chinese holiday (Spring Festival, Dragon Boat, May Day, Summer Vacation, Mid-Autumn, National Day), at either the NATIONAL (全国) or CITY (城市) dimension. National mode produces the four-deliverable set (dataset CSV + Economist/FT-style HTML report + data provenance + landing page) using a five-stage pipeline with a 22-field caliber dictionary and a continuity/forecast framework. City mode adds a 30-field city layer that reconciles (勾稽) to the national SSOT dataset, with inline-SVG visualizations. Before any collection, the skill resolves three parameters — [年份] (defaults to current year), [节日] (defaults to the festival of the current date), [地域] (defaults to 全国; a named city triggers city mode) — and proactively prompts the user when any cannot be derived. Collection is delegated to the holiday-data-fetch skill (called in stage one, gated by the three contracts); this skill owns parameter resolution, analysis, and delivery. Use when the user requests a Chinese-holiday consumption/spending data report, nationally or for a specific city.
